payload.title: Use shared monitoring and steering in DataParade limited posts
payload.description:
PLANNING ONLY. Ryan requested filing and design before implementation. This issue is not authorization to build runtime features, deploy, change cloud permissions, publish packages, push, or migrate production data. Keep open pending design review and separate implementation authorization.

As a DataParade editor, I want the complete shared Cyclotron operator experience beside limited posts, so that embedded mode remains understandable and steerable without a lab UI.

Feature: DataParade embedded operator acceptance
  Scenario: Inspect and steer the limited-posts classifier
    Given the deployment owns its embedded posts classifier and an authorized editor opens its controls
    When the editor inspects a candidate and its decision
    Then real shared components expose versioned prediction, explicit labels and explanations
    And classifier monitoring and steering are available with the same observable semantics as remote mode
    And the action targets the local deployment's classifier data
  Scenario: No examples or measurements yet
    Given the small posts section has no curated examples or measured alignment
    When an editor opens the controls
    Then missing measurements are identified honestly
    And optional research-paper or web priming remains separate from normal operation
  Scenario: Contract parity
    Given the shared conformance scenarios and equivalent authorized fixture state
    When they run against embedded and remote adapters
    Then labels, explanation history, version identity and steering outcomes satisfy the same reviewed contract
    And embedded mode makes no remote-lab or external-store dependency mandatory

Design review / future Definition of Done: review these observable acceptance cases with the shared contract; executable specs and implementation are future work after authorization.
Consume shared UI/contract story once; this story is application/mode acceptance, not a second component implementation. Open: navigation placement, local capabilities and limits for a small deployment. Preserve unified local preview work as evidence, not proof of production readiness.

Preserve optional curated-example priming (decision-flywheel-da886c09-7acb-45d3-acf8-c81585f26d8a), its preview/revision/explicit-label acceptance contract, and separate existing scholarly research-paper and web-summary transformations. Priming must never become an onboarding gate. Common input items are distinct from publication-specific decisions; one publication accepting an item must never implicitly label another output.
